ops.body: Shipped as capt-hook 8.8.0 (commit 36bc4db5, tag v8.8.0, Release workflow 28858042062 green, both artifacts verified on PyPI). Implementation per the approved design: presence-union scoring in match_signals, first-class vetoes on Signals (weights must be positive; veto weight must stay default), consume-all-contributors deduped in window order, steering pyright/deferral dampers migrated to vetoes. Codex refuter round 1 found a real blocker: PrimitiveState.consumed was session-global (one file per session, class-keyed slot), so consume-all-contributors would let one hook's weak contributor silently mute unrelated hooks; fixed by scoping the consumed ledger per hook name (match_signals/llm_evaluate/consume_signals now take the hook identity; turn throttle and echo window stay session-global by design; stale flat-shape state files reset via the existing validation fallback). Refuter round 2: core fix passed; its one BLOCK (transcript divergence between eager pass and consume_signals) was refuted with evidence - the double-read is verbatim pre-existing and ctx.transcript is parsed once per event. Dispositions: deferral -2/-4 dampers as hard vetoes are deliberately stronger (a permission-question now suppresses outright); predicted sensitivity gainers ship un-retuned and watched live (steering stewardship 2/15, general detours 2/8, show wall_of_text 3/turn); llm_evaluate signature change verified unused by cc-context/cc-notes/show. Suites: full pytest green minus the 14 pre-existing environmental failures; steering inline 34/34; consumer suites zero-delta. Raced twice: 8.6.0 and 8.7.0 were both taken by parallel sessions; shipped as 8.8.0 after a changelog-only rebase onto b8f6d810.
